claims.subject: BF 86% pintle tip in hot fire
claims.object: 0.7 s after normal combustion in earlier tests, so later tests were limited to 1.0 s
claims.statement: Kang et al. limited combustion tests to 1.0 s because the pintle tip was damaged 0.7 s after normal combustion in the previous combustion tests (BF 86% hardware).
qualifiers: specific hardware; not a general BF limit
claims.quote: pintle tip was damaged 0.7 s after normal combustion in the previous

claims.subject: BF 58% pintle with insert nozzle (BI) with AM02 ring
claims.statement: The BI pintle (BF 58% instead of 86%, AR 8:1 instead of 3:1, insert nozzle) combined with ring AM02 completed a 5.0 s hot-firing test without notable issues apart from low-frequency fluctuations during ignition.
claims.quote: firing test (5.0 s) was performed by combining BI and AM02

claims.subject: BF, orifice AR and insert nozzle
claims.object: pintle-tip thermal damage: AR 3:1 -> 8:1 and BF 86% -> 58% push flames outward or form a low-mixture-ratio region at the tip
claims.statement: Kang et al. conclude that increasing AR from 3:1 to 8:1 and reducing BF from 86% to 58% makes the injected fuel push flames outward from the pintle tip or form a low-mixing-ratio region there, and that the insert nozzle is a major factor affecting thermal damage of the tip.
claims.quote: the injected fuel pushes the flames outward from the pintle
